mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month indicates a weakening labor market, which negatively impacts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when UNRATE increases by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts by more than 5% over two months signals a weakening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when HOUST declines by more than 5% over two months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% over a month signals a strengthening supply side of the economy, leading to increased productivity and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when INDPRO increases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures by more than 1% over three months signals a strengthening consumer demand, leading to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when RSAFS increases by more than 1% over three months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 2% and CPI inflation exceeds 3% year-over-year, the real interest rate becomes positive, indicating a restrictive monetary policy that negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation and restrictive monetary policy
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate decreases by more than 0.2% within a month, it signals a strong labor market, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200,000 and UNRATE decrease > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP by more than 0.5% over a quarter signals a weakening economy, leading to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when GDPC1 decreases by more than 0.5%.
